## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Clumsy Bandage | Your first aid is awkward and ineffective. The patient gains no immediate benefit from your treatment. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Poorly Cleaned Wound | You fail to clean the injury properly. The wound remains vulnerable, and infection risk increases at the GM's discretion. | Moderate |  |
| 21-23 | Panic at Blood | The sight of the injury shakes you. Suffer 1 point of damage to Empathy, and the treatment stalls. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Worsened Pain | You touch a sensitive injury the wrong way. The patient suffers additional pain and may refuse further treatment for a while. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Wrong Remedy | You use the wrong herbs, splints, or method. The recovery attempt fails, and the patient must wait before trying again. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Opened Wound | Your work reopens the injury. The patient bleeds again and the original wound becomes harder to treat. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Wasted Supplies | Bandages, herbs, or other medicine are used up with little effect. Lose one relevant item or supply, GM's choice. | Low |  |
| 44-46 | Shaken Patient | The patient loses confidence and becomes difficult to treat. Any further healing attempt on that patient suffers a setback until calmed. | Moderate |  |
| 51-53 | Hidden Complication | You miss a deeper injury or illness. The patient appears stable, but a serious problem remains untreated. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Fever Breaks Out | The wound or illness worsens into fever or infection. The patient takes a severe turn for the worse unless treated quickly. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Failed Save | The patient slips from your care at the worst moment. A critical injury or broken condition remains unresolved, and time is lost. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Life on the Brink | Your attempt goes disastrously wrong and the patient is left in immediate danger. Another intervention is needed at once or the outcome may become fatal. | Catastrophic |  |
